```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  filter(!is.na(wk1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wk1)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10) +
  labs(
    x = "Week 1 ranking",
    y = "Number of songs",
    subtitle = paste("Number of values:", sum(!is.na(billboard$wk1)))
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  select(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "ranking"
  ) |>
  group_by(week) |>
  summarize(
    missing = sum(is.na(ranking)),
    present = sum(!is.na(ranking))
  )
```

```{r Last}
billboard |>
  filter(!is.na(wk20), if_all(wk21:wk76, is.na)) |>
  summarize(
    songs = n(),
    ranked_below_50 = sum(wk20 > 50)
  )
```

```{r}
song_summary <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  group_by(artist, track, date.entered) |>
  summarize(
    first_rank = first(na.omit(rank)),
    best_rank = min(rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_week_at_best_rank = min(
      week[!is.na(rank) & rank == min(rank, na.rm = TRUE)]
    ),
    total_weeks = sum(!is.na(rank)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top_10_songs <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10)

top_10_trajectories <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    top_10_songs |> select(artist, track, date.entered),
    by = c("artist", "track", "date.entered")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    notable = case_when(
      artist == "Madonna" & track == "Music" ~ "Madonna — Music",
      artist == "Lonestar" & track == "Amazed" ~ "Lonestar — Amazed",
      artist == "Creed" & track == "Higher" ~ "Creed — Higher",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

top_10_trajectories |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track))) +
  geom_line(color = "gray75", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(
    data = top_10_trajectories |> filter(!is.na(notable)),
    aes(color = notable),
    linewidth = 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Week", y = "Ranking", color = "Notable song")

bind_rows(
  top_10_songs |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_min(first_week_at_best_rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(trajectory = "Fastest to number one"),
  top_10_songs |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_max(first_week_at_best_rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(trajectory = "Slowest to number one"),
  top_10_songs |>
    slice_max(total_weeks, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(trajectory = "Longest chart run")
) |>
  select(trajectory, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank,
         first_week_at_best_rank, total_weeks) |>
  print(width = Inf)
```
